checks.rationale: Check that a synthetic identifier in the query string stays out of the diagnostic.
covers: query strings are not incorporated into error diagnostics

checks.rationale: Run the existing logging and readiness tests on both revisions.
The generic 500 response remains byte-identical for the same synthetic route failure.
A benign synthetic failure still produces a request-correlated error log and the generic response on both revisions.
The original path disclosure must reproduce on the vulnerable base and be absent after the patch.
covers: task IDs do not appear in unhandled-error logs

checks.rationale: Run the HTTP application integration tests on the patched source, including authentication, middleware and readiness handling.
An unmatched URL containing a synthetic email-shaped value and a query token is an independent user-controlled path variant.
covers: arbitrary unmatched path segments do not appear in logs

finding.summary: Unhandled request diagnostics log the concrete URL path, exposing internal task IDs and user-controlled unmatched path segments in retained logs
